entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used as input to integrity protection and verification algorithms. Sender uses locally stored NAS COUNT, receiver estimates NAS COUNT from sequence number and overflow counter.

entities.name: SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE
entities.description: NAS message that undergoes integrity protection including octet 7 to n (Sequence number IE and NAS message IE).

entities.name: Integrity protection algorithm
entities.description: Algorithm specified in 3GPP TS 33.501 that calculates integrity protection information using BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, and 5G NAS integrity key as inputs.

entities.name: Integrity verification
entities.description: Process of validating integrity protection using NAS COUNT estimate. Not applicable when 5G-IA0 is used.

entities.name: 5G-IA0
entities.description: Condition where integrity algorithm 5G-IA0 is used, making integrity verification not applicable.

entities.name: NAS transparent container IE
entities.description: Information element where integrity protection includes all octets of the value part starting from octet 7.

relations.description: SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE requires integrity protection by the integrity protection algorithm.
Integrity protection algorithm uses NAS COUNT as input parameter.
Integrity verification uses estimated NAS COUNT as input and updates local NAS COUNT after successful validation.
Integrity verification is not applicable when 5G-IA0 condition is true.
NAS transparent container IE requires integrity protection including all octets from octet 7.
